7.5.questions_where: https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/google/facts-parametric (1,052 public items stated as released; direct download file not located)
7.5.summary: 2,104 hard factoid questions drawn from real Google Search queries, answered from memory and graded against a gold answer. Very close, fresher stand-in for Yugos's simpleqa_verified part (SimpleQA-style but different source); only the 1,052 public half is usable, if its download can be found.

chat.why: Short factoid and multi-hop questions with short gold answers (judge graded), hotpotqa/simpleqa-like, but they are meant to be answered with a web-search tool; Yugos chat gives no tool, so closed-book difficulty differs.

math_code.why: different skill: fact retrieval, no math or code

agentic.why: Real tool use (one Brave Search tool, up to 7 hops) in a multi-step loop, but only one generic tool, graded on the final answer against gold, not function-call AST or end state; prompt+tool lengths not stated.

7.6.questions_where: https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/google/facts-search (890 public items stated as released; direct download file not located)
7.6.summary: 1,884 questions (890 public, 994 private per paper/blog; the row says 1,842) that require web search: hard-tail facts and Wikipedia/KG multi-hop. Usable as hard closed-book fact/multi-hop chat questions or as a weak single-tool agentic example.

chat.why: different skill: every question needs an image (Yugos is text-only); long-form answers judged on rubrics

math_code.why: different skill: image questions

agentic.why: different skill: image questions, no tools

7.7.questions_where: https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/google/facts-multimodal (711 public items stated as released; direct download file not located)
7.7.summary: About 1,522 image-based questions (711 public, 811 private per paper) answered in long form and judged on coverage/no-contradiction rubrics. Not usable for Yugos, which sends text only.
